title: Afternoon traffic and safety

items.label: I-880 NB · Bascom Ave
items.text: Traffic hazard on NB I-880 just north of the Bascom Ave on-ramp (NB 880 JNO BASCOM), San Jose, ~12:39–12:41 PM PT. Metal frame in lane 1 and ladder in lane 4; no associated vehicles (CHP #1271). Unit assigned/enroute 12:41 PM; still active ~12:58 PM. Matters for Bascom / east-of-Campbell 880 access from Union Ave.

items.label: Moorpark Ave · San Jose
items.text: Still on board from midday: collision with ambulance en route at 2400 Moorpark Ave (~12:04 PM PT). Near I-280 / Winchester.
